title: Treatise of the Twin Tao Sovereign
summary: A treatise on two Ways walked as one and the sovereign calm that rules a field where both are held at once.

title: Book of the Core Tao and the Two Horizons
summary: A book of the Tao kept in the Core and spread to two horizons at once as a single even calm.

title: Oath-Book of the Plateau Tao-Bearer
summary: An oath-book for the one who carries the Tao across the plateau and lays its quiet weight on those who break the peace.

title: Canon of the Oathcore Way
summary: A canon of an oath kept in the Core and a Way that bears it out in strikes that natural law will not let fall.
